normative_clauses.statement: G.D6 Accepted = every mandatory contract condition passes.
No weighted score, no majority vote, no partial acceptance, no discretionary override, no compensation between failed and passed conditions. One failed mandatory condition means G.D6 is not accepted.
The contract itself must not mark G.D6 as accepted. It only defines the future decision rule.
After Acceptance Contract v1.0 and Benchmark Manifest v1.0 are independently accepted and frozen, no new G.D6 acceptance criterion may be introduced during the same evaluation cycle.
If the frozen verifier passes every mandatory benchmark item, G.D6 must be accepted under Contract v1.0.

The contract may be reopened only after presentation of a Reproducible Material Counterexample satisfying all five conditions: exact input or fixture, exact execution command, reproducible on frozen commit, incorrect verifier pass, and claim-relevant material effect.

Hypothetical concerns without executable evidence, code-style preferences, naming improvements, formatting changes, speed optimizations, additional defense-in-depth outside frozen claims, edge cases outside declared trust boundary, and defects that cannot affect a paper claim do not reopen G.D6.
The framework is a bounded empirical verification contract, not a formal proof.
Trusted infrastructure components are trusted assumptions, not verified conclusions.
The future frozen verifier path is scripts/verify_gd6_frozen_benchmark_v1.py and the execution pattern is python3 scripts/verify_gd6_frozen_benchmark_v1.py.

scientific_claims.statement: The frozen policy implementation classifies the defined valid and invalid cases according to the frozen reconciliation policy and benchmark. This claim is bounded to the listed benchmark and invariants. It is not a claim of universal correctness.
scientific_claims.title: Correct Classification

basis.supported_proposition: policy_approved, policy_enforced, production_execution_authorized, part3b_complete, part3c_authorized are all false

scientific_claims.statement: G.D6 classification must never independently produce final approval, policy enforcement, production authorization, Part 3B completion, or Part 3C authorization.
scientific_claims.title: No Unauthorized Approval or Enforcement

basis.supported_proposition: protected_files_unchanged is true and recursive_snapshot_changed is 0

scientific_claims.statement: The G.D6 verification process must not alter canonical Part 1 artifacts, existing Part 3B artifacts, frozen policy evidence, or frozen reconciliation evidence.
scientific_claims.title: Artifact Preservation

basis.supported_proposition: forced_exception_test_passed is true and rollback_all_scenarios_passed is true

scientific_claims.statement: After an injected exception or transactional-publication failure, patched global objects must be restored, protected files must retain their prior state, temporary and backup files must not remain, and publication state must be restored.
scientific_claims.title: Recoverability

scientific_claims.statement: An independent evaluator must be able to execute the frozen verifier in a clean environment using the documented command and obtain the same Pass/Fail decision.
scientific_claims.title: Reproducible Verification

critical.description: A reproducible defect that can alter a paper result, grant unauthorized approval, authorize production, enforce policy, modify protected artifacts, or make the frozen verifier incorrectly pass a mandatory mutation.
critical.effect: blocks acceptance; reopens accepted G.D6 if discovered later

major.description: A reproducible defect that prevents independent execution, invalidates environment provenance, breaks JSON/Markdown consistency, makes required rollback or restoration evidence incomplete, or makes mandatory benchmark evidence unavailable.

minor.description: A defect limited to naming, formatting, refactoring, non-material documentation improvement, performance optimization, or non-claim-relevant cleanup.
minor.effect: recorded but does not block acceptance

stopping_rule.statement: After Acceptance Contract v1.0 and Benchmark Manifest v1.0 are independently accepted and frozen, no new G.D6 acceptance criterion may be introduced during the same evaluation cycle.
